# Lairy

> Lairy is a design system with the visual language of an operator console: dark-first, monospaced, amber-accented, with a locked 2px corner.

## Components

- [Badges](/components/badge): A small, square, system-assigned label stating a standing condition on a row. The operator cannot dismiss it.
- [Buttons](/components/button): Commits an action the operator has decided to take.
- [Callout](/components/callout): Reports a standing condition inside the panel or flow it belongs to.
- [Cards](/components/card): A bordered container that holds one whole object worth looking at on its own.
- [Checkbox](/components/checkbox): Records an independent yes-or-no the operator sets themselves.
- [Chips](/components/chip): A round-ended token representing a value the operator chose, such as a filter. The operator can dismiss it.
- [Empty state](/components/empty-state): What a region says when it has loaded successfully and has nothing to show.
- [Header](/components/header): Names the selected top-level module and carries ambient reference and the operator's own identity. Chrome, not content.
- [Loading](/components/loading): What a region shows while it still does not know the answer.
- [Navigation (Main)](/components/main-rail): The full-height column on the left that moves the operator between workspaces. The one navigation in the product that never changes.
- [Popover](/components/popover): A small anchored overlay holding a short action list or a few detail pairs.
- [Progress](/components/progress): Reports a measured fraction of a known total, and nothing else.
- [Radio](/components/radio): A set of mutually exclusive options, all visible at once, exactly one of them chosen.
- [Scrollbar](/components/scrollbar): The browser's own scroll control, restyled to two greys — never a custom-built replacement.
- [Navigation (Subnav)](/components/subnav): The column of pages inside one workspace, docked to the right of the main rail. The one navigation that changes with the route.
- [Switch](/components/switch): Turns one setting on or off, and the change takes effect the moment it moves.
- [Table](/components/table): A list of records the operator works on, not a grid of numbers they read.
- [Navigation (Tabs)](/components/tabs): Switches between views of the page the operator is already on, with nothing else changing.
- [Text](/components/text): Renders a block of copy in its role — eyebrow, heading, body or caption — with no typographic decision left to make at the point of use.
- [Text input](/components/text-input): One line the operator types into, and the box every other field in the system is measured against.
- [Textarea](/components/textarea): The text input grown tall enough to hold a sentence the operator writes in their own words.
- [Tooltip](/components/tooltip): Names the thing under the pointer, in one line, and holds nothing the operator has to reach.
- [Usage card](/components/usage-card): The paired "use when / use something else when" card on a docs page. Not an operator-facing component outside documentation.
